Pathfinder Toolkit › Bestiary › Level 5

Tomb Raider

Creature 5 Mediumhumanhumanoid

Perception +13

Languages Common

Skills Acrobatics +13, Architecture Lore +11, Athletics +13, Deception +7, Engineering Lore +11, Society +9, Stealth +11, Thievery +13

Str +3, Dex +4, Con +1, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +0

Items hand crossbow, kukri, climbing kit, bolts (20)

Hazard Spotter Even if the tomb raider isn't Searching, they get a check to find traps that normally require them to be Searching.

AC 21; Fort +10, Ref +15, Will +11

HP 75

Speed 25 feet, climb 15 feet

Melee ◆ kukri +15 [+11/+7] (agile, trip), Damage 1d6+9 slashing

Melee ◆ fist +15 [+11/+7] (agile, finesse, nonlethal, unarmed), Damage 1d4+9 bludgeoning

Ranged ◆ hand crossbow +15 [+10/+5] (reload 1, range increment 60 feet), Damage 1d6+6 piercing

Trick Attack ◆ The tomb raider chooses one of their weapons. The next attack with that weapon this turn deals an additional 2d6 precision damage. In addition, the tomb raider can Interact to draw or reload the weapon.

👹 Build an Encounter ⚔️ Add to Initiative

Where to meet one

The Pathfinder Encounter Builder rolls the tomb raider for fights in 🏚️ dungeon or ruin.
